text:
maria: Quick RFC follow-up — proposal to merge abuse-signal scoring into the admission layer (so admissions return (allow|soft-allow|deny) + score). Thoughts?

alex: 👍 idea but alarm: synchronous scoring adds latency to hot paths. we need a provisional flow or cached score.

jamal: we experimented with provisional admits in perf lab last quarter. brief notes: p50 unchanged, p95 +2ms, p99 +10-15ms when classifier cold.

rui: what about a hybrid: cached score + probabilistic probing. admission checks cache, if miss do provisional admit + async score and reconcile. fallback policy could be token-costly but preserves latency.

maria: agree hybrid makes sense. need concrete API surface: admission should return admission_id + provisional flag + effective_weight. runtime can accept provisional and later apply revoke/penalty via admit_patch.

alex: API sketch:
```
POST /admit { tenant, route, tokens } -> { admit_id, status: "provisional|ok|denied", weight, score_version }
PATCH /admit/:id { status: "deny" | "downgrade", reason }
```
We should avoid blocking generator on PATCH though.

jamal: operational concern: if we PATCH to deny after tokens consumed, what do we do? charge-back is ugly. options: 1) keep best-effort reconcile for internal metrics only, 2) try to short-circuit subsequent requests and throttle, 3) return soft-deny token refunds for enterprise customers via billing pipeline.

rui: prefer (2) + (1). enforce future rejects quickly via tenant-level valve. refunds only for clearly abusive cases and under manual review.

maria: also need telemetry: admit_id must be attached to logs/traces and stored in the quota store for 24h. rollouts require an A/B that compares provisional vs synchronous scoring on same traffic.

ops-bot: deploy: canary admission-provisional v0.3 -> eng-platform-canary (10%) :rocket:

alex: action items: (a) I’ll draft the admission API PR with optional admit_patch (b) Jamal to run microbench with cached TTL 1s/5s/30s and measure p99, (c) Rui to propose reconciliation playbook for post-consumption denials. target sync next Tue.

maria: thanks — adding to RFC thread and linking tests. :thumbsup:
